disposition_reason: Original flame AAS measurements of lead, cadmium and zinc in 60 samples of six vegetables from Babol farms, reported as per-vegetable means on a dry-weight basis.

study.design: Farm sampling of six vegetables with Monte Carlo health risk assessment
study.origin: vegetable farms in four agricultural regions of Babol, Mazandaran Province, Iran
study.method: Flame AAS (PG Instruments 990) after hot-plate HNO3/HClO4/H2SO4 (5:1:1) digestion of oven-dried (80 °C) edible parts
study.lod_text: Method detection limits 0.0028 mg/L (Cd), 0.003 mg/L (Zn), 0.012 mg/L (Pb) in solution
study.qa: Three blanks per batch; 5-8 point calibration; triplicate readings; no CRM or recovery reported
